title: SecOps Triage
voice_instructions: Warm, clear, confident technical product narration in natural American English. Speak at about 145 words per minute, with brief pauses between sentences. Avoid a sales pitch or exaggerated excitement. Pronounce SecOps as seck-ops, SIEM as seem, SDK as S D K, AWS as A W S, EC2 as E C two, EBS as E B S, and SSM as S S M. Read only the supplied text. Do not add words, music, or sound effects.

scenes.heading: Approved training. A suspicious follow-up.
scenes.subheading: The second email has a different link that needs investigation.
scenes.narration: The first email is an approved security-training exercise. A similar follow-up has a different link that was clicked and flagged malicious by synthetic intelligence. SecOps Triage gathers the evidence to investigate that suspicious second email.

scenes.heading: One incident. One investigation.
scenes.subheading: Recorded local workflow  /  Synthetic evidence  /  Scripted provider
scenes.narration: Here, we select a reported phishing incident and start the investigation. This recording uses synthetic evidence and a scripted provider through the real Strands Agents SDK. No live model inference runs here.

scenes.heading: The agent gathers the context behind the alert.
scenes.subheading: 4 scoped tools  →  9 evidence reads  →  One inspectable packet
scenes.narration: The Strands agent gathers incident details, entity context, activity, and related cases through four scoped tools. Nine evidence reads bring messages, clicks, intelligence, and business authorization into one inspectable packet.

scenes.heading: First: approved training. Second: suspicious follow-up.
scenes.subheading: The follow-up link was clicked and flagged malicious by synthetic intelligence
scenes.narration: The first message has explicit training approval. The follow-up has a different link and a recorded click. The approval names only the first message. It does not cover the follow-up.

scenes.heading: Inspect the exact link behind the recommendation.
scenes.subheading: Agent-retrieved source  /  Host-policy recommendation  /  Analyst review
scenes.narration: The agent retrieved intelligence for the exact follow-up link. Open its citation: the synthetic source says malicious. Host policy recommends investigation; the analyst can inspect why. Credential theft remains unproven.

scenes.heading: Leave the next analyst a concrete next step.
scenes.subheading: Automated demonstration  /  Saved locally  /  Source SIEM unchanged
scenes.narration: The next step is concrete: request an authorized identity audit export and inspect the follow-up link. The operator saves the reason, missing context, and next action with this evidence packet.

scenes.heading: Framework, provider and host: explicit boundaries
scenes.subheading: Current UI: local  /  AWS service verification: completed separately
scenes.narration: Strands orchestrates the tools; the provider is scripted; host controls enforce scope, storage, and decisions. Separately, we verified a scripted run on AWS EC2, with encrypted EBS, SSM access, and CloudWatch delivery. That host is now stopped.

scenes.heading: From alert to evidence-backed analyst handoff.
scenes.narration: Gather the context. Inspect the evidence. Preserve the next step. SecOps Triage: from alert to evidence-backed analyst handoff.
